meetings.headline: Sewer Commission signed the I&I study contract and backed a three-lot Cross Street sewer area request 4-1.
meetings.summary: The commission discussed Elizabeth Street infiltration, a warning letter to Small Water over a cancelled meeting, and the Woodard and Curran I&I study contract, which it voted to sign. It then voted 4-1 to support the Cross Street sewer service area request, with the three-lot plan, for Town Meeting. It also authorized signing a partial betterment release for 101 Pleasant Street.

what_happened.line: The commission voted 4-1 to back the three-lot Cross Street sewer service area plan and take it to Town Meeting.
A motion to sign the Woodard and Curran I&I study contract was put to the commission; the minutes record the vote as not audible.
A motion to send a warning letter to Small Water, with 'days' changed to 'hours', was put; the vote is recorded as not audible.
The commission voted to authorize the chair or another member to sign a partial betterment release for 101 Pleasant Street.
No November 12 meeting will be held; the next meeting is November 19 with Small Water, and Pierce is asked to present a draft maintenance plan in December.

why_it_matters: The Cross Street vote adds sewer service area, which Town Meeting voters will be asked to decide, and the I&I study bears on a possible added charge from Leominster in future sewer budgets.
Sewer invoices will also carry the annual irrigation meter program fee.
watch_next: November 19 meeting with Small Water, where the corrected letter and the I&I contract may come up.
Town Meeting vote on the Cross Street three-lot sewer service area.
